name: LavaLending
fix_description: In latestAnswer, getAssetsBasedOnPrice reads pool balances that can be manipulated via flash loan (changing r0/r1 ratio). Even though oracle prices p0/p1 are used, the pool reserves r0/r1 are from instantaneous state. Fix: use TWAP-based pool reserves or add a manipulation check comparing the reported balances against expected ranges based on oracle prices.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a long, highly protocol-specific multi-contract attack chain involving nested flash loans from four sources, LP deposit/withdraw/compound mechanics, lending market collateral manipulation, oracle/price-sensitive borrowing, and multiple swap callbacks. Writing it requires deep understanding of the vulnerable protocol’s accounting and how several external protocols interact, which is well beyond a straightforward exploit.
